title: REST endpoint naming trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for rest-endpoint-naming trace events: the routing table of an API surface plus the request currently going through it.

service.description: Display name of the API whose surface is being built.

routes.description: The routing table, one entry per URL, in registration order.

kind.description: What the path names: many things of one kind, one identified thing, or a part of an identified thing.

methods.description: The HTTP methods registered on this URL, in registration order.

name.description: The HTTP method, untranslated (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD).

current.description: Whether the request being processed was routed to this method.

smells.description: Naming findings for this path; the technical code only, the reason is in the event description.

request.description: The request being routed (absent while the surface is only being built).

method.description: The HTTP method the client sent, untranslated.

path.description: The path the client asked for, without the query string.

query.description: Query string parameters as sent, in order.

status.description: HTTP status line ('200 OK', '405 Method Not Allowed'), or 'pending' while the request is still being routed.

matchedPath.description: The registered URL the request landed on, or null when no URL matched.

endpoints.description: How many method+path pairs the surface exposes.

paths.description: How many distinct URLs those endpoints are spread over.

smells.description: Total number of naming findings across the surface.
